title: The manager session's SessionStart publish --hook publishes to the public home at every start and compaction; an unattended /loop manager has no way to switch it off
goal: kbpublic.cmd_publish_hook returns 0 and publishes nothing when KB_NO_PUBLISH_HOOK is set (non-empty), as it already does for KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER; the operator's own interactive sessions, with the variable unset, keep today's behaviour; a planted-failure test runs the hook with the variable set (nothing published) and unset (published); the runbook starts the manager session with the variable exported (the manager must not use KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER: that would block its --by operator answers); the manager's manager decision (mac-fifth, operator away): forbid publish on compaction for the manager; found by the SP-itmjxudu review

run: import os,sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbpublic as k;os.environ["KB_NO_PUBLISH_HOOK"]="1";called=[];k.publish_remote=lambda cwd:"pub";k.cmd_publish=lambda a,cwd:called.append(1);r=k.cmd_publish_hook(types.SimpleNamespace(remote=None),".");print(r,called);sys.exit(1 if called else 0)
